name: Create Custom CSR
description: Create Custom CSR Generate a new custom Certificate Signing Request (CSR) for a zone. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_csrs
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_csrs
Generate a new custom Certificate Signing Request (CSR) for a zone. Cloudflare generates and securely stores the private key associated with the CSR. The CSR can then be provided to a Certificate Authority for signing. Once signed, the certificate is uploaded via the Custom SSL endpoint using the CSR ID.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Custom CSR Details
description: Custom CSR Details Retrieve details for a specific custom Certificate Signing Request (CSR). GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_csrs/{custom_csr_id}

name: Delete Custom CSR
description: Delete Custom CSR Delete a custom Certificate Signing Request (CSR) and its associated private key. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_csrs/{custom_csr_id}

name: List Custom CSRs
description: List Custom CSRs List all custom Certificate Signing Requests (CSRs) for a zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_csrs
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/custom_csrs
List all custom Certificate Signing Requests (CSRs) for a zone.
Required: zone_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query)
